prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: chickpeas pouring in a golden cascade into a hot pan, popping and jumping in spiced oil. The camera follows a wooden spoon folding coconut milk into a bubbling red curry, color swirling hypnotically. Money shot: the curry ladled over steaming basmati rice, cilantro leaves falling in slow motion, backlit steam rolling off the bowl. Final beat: the bowl on the table beside warm flatbread being torn. Warm dramatic light, deep shadows, macro on the curry texture, film grain. Dominant sound: the chickpea sizzle, then the ladle pour. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
